summary.sl: Najvišja slovenska gora in središče Triglavskega narodnega parka. Vse označene poti na vrh se združijo na grebenu čez Mali Triglav, ki je zavarovan in izpostavljen. Izbira pristopa vpliva na dolžino in težavnost hoje do koče, ne pa na zahtevnost zadnjega dela.
summary.en: The highest mountain in Slovenia and the heart of Triglav National Park. Every marked route to the summit converges on the ridge over Mali Triglav, which is cabled and seriously exposed. Your choice of approach changes the length and difficulty of the walk to the hut, but not the difficulty of the final section.

note.sl: Skupen vsem smerem — velja ne glede na izbrano pot.
note.en: Common to every route — applies whichever approach you choose.

summary.sl: Najbolj obiskan hrib v Sloveniji in domači vzpon Ljubljančanov. Široka, dobro utrjena pot brez izpostavljenih mest, primerna vse leto in za prvi vzpon. Pozimi je spodnji del pogosto poledenel.
summary.en: The busiest hill in Slovenia and Ljubljana's local climb. A wide, well-worn path with no exposure, walkable year round and a sensible first summit. The lower section often ices over in winter.

summary.sl: Kraška planota nad Vipavsko dolino z izrazitim robom in razgledom do morja. Vzpon iz Vipave je kratek po razdalji, a ima skoraj 1150 metrov višinske razlike — zato ni tako lahek, kot pove nadmorska višina. Znan po burji, ki lahko piha nevarno močno.
summary.en: A karst plateau above the Vipava valley with a sharp edge and a view to the sea. The climb from Vipava is short in distance but gains almost 1150 metres — so it is a far bigger day than the summit altitude suggests. Known for the burja, a wind that can blow dangerously hard.

summary.sl: Samostojen, strm vrh nad Preddvorom, viden iz velikega dela Gorenjske. Vse poti so strme in v zgornjem delu potekajo po melišču in skalnatem svetu. Ob snegu zahteva zimsko opremo in izkušnje.
summary.en: A steep, free-standing peak above Preddvor, visible from much of Gorenjska. Every route is steep and the upper section crosses scree and rock. With snow on it, it demands winter equipment and experience.

summary.sl: Mogočen vrh nad Soško dolino in eno najbolj razglednih mest v Julijcih. Med prvo svetovno vojno je bil del soške fronte; ostanki so še vidni. Vzpon je dolg, a tehnično nezahteven.
summary.en: A commanding summit above the Soča valley and one of the finest viewpoints in the Julian Alps. It was part of the Isonzo front in the First World War and the remains are still visible. The ascent is long but technically straightforward.

summary.sl: Najvišji vrh slovenske Istre z razgledom od Triglava do Jadrana. Travnat, položen vrh, dostopen tudi pozimi, ko je v gorah že sneg. Poleti zgodaj vroče in brez sence.
summary.en: The highest summit in Slovenian Istria, with a view from Triglav to the Adriatic. A grassy, gentle top that stays walkable in winter when the Alps are already under snow. In summer it gets hot early and offers no shade.

summary.sl: Obmejni greben nad Mežiško dolino; najvišji vrh je Kordeževa glava. Manj obiskana kot Julijci, s širokim razgledom na Karavanke in Avstrijo. Po ljudskem izročilu tu spi kralj Matjaž.
summary.en: A border ridge above the Mežica valley, its highest point Kordeževa glava. Much quieter than the Julian Alps, with a wide view over the Karavanke and into Austria. Folklore has King Matjaž asleep under this mountain.

summary.sl: Travnat vrh v Karavankah nad Jesenicami, najbolj znan po pobočjih narcis konec aprila in v maju. Pot je razgledna in tehnično nezahtevna, zgornji del je odprt in izpostavljen vetru. V času cvetenja je gneča velika.
summary.en: A grassy summit in the Karavanke above Jesenice, best known for its slopes of wild daffodils in late April and May. The path is scenic and technically undemanding; the upper section is open and wind-exposed. Expect crowds during the bloom.

summary.sl: Ena najbolj prepoznavnih silhuet v Julijcih in simbol slovenskega alpinizma. Vse poti na vrh so zavarovane, dolge in izpostavljene; to ni gora za prvi obisk visokogorja.
summary.en: One of the most recognisable silhouettes in the Julian Alps and a symbol of Slovenian alpinism. Every route to the top is cabled, long and exposed; this is not a mountain for a first visit to the high country.

summary.sl: Tretji najvišji vrh Slovenije, dostopen z najvišje ceste v državi. Prav zato je razpon težavnosti velik: z Mangartskega sedla je vzpon kratek, iz doline pa cel dan.
summary.en: The third-highest summit in Slovenia, reached from the highest road in the country. That makes the range of difficulty unusually wide: short from the saddle, a full day from the valley.

summary.sl: Znan po velikem naravnem oknu v severni steni, ki ga je videti s ceste čez Vršič. Vse označene poti so zavarovane in zahtevajo čelado ter samovarovalni komplet.
summary.en: Known for the great natural window in its north face, visible from the Vršič road. Every marked route is cabled and needs a helmet and a via ferrata set.

summary.sl: Strm, piramidast vrh nad Gozdom Martuljkom z eno najlepših severnih sten v Julijcih. Označena pot je dolga in v zgornjem delu zavarovana.
summary.en: A steep, pyramidal peak above Gozd Martuljek with one of the finest north faces in the Julian Alps. The marked route is long and cabled in its upper section.

summary.sl: Najlažji dvatisočak v Julijcih in pogosta prva visoka gora. Z Rudnega polja je vzpon kratek, pot pa je razgledna in tehnično nezahtevna.
summary.en: The easiest two-thousander in the Julian Alps and a common first high summit. Short from Rudno polje, with wide views and no technical difficulty.

summary.sl: Razgleden robni vrh nad Pokljuko z lepim pogledom na Triglav. Pot je lahka in primerna za družine, zgornji del pa je odprt in izpostavljen vetru.
summary.en: A viewpoint on the edge of the Pokljuka plateau with a fine outlook on Triglav. The path is easy and family-friendly, though the top is open and wind-exposed.

summary.sl: Vrh nad Bohinjskim jezerom, dostopen tudi z nihalko. Poleti travnat in prijeten, pozimi smučišče; razgled na Triglav in jezero je eden najboljših v Bohinju.
summary.en: A summit above Lake Bohinj, reachable by cable car. Grassy and pleasant in summer, a ski area in winter; the view of Triglav and the lake is among the best in Bohinj.

summary.sl: Vzhodni rob Julijcev, znan po izjemno bogatem rastlinstvu. Vzpon iz Bohinjske Bistrice je dolg in enakomeren, vrh pa je travnat greben z razgledom na obe strani.
summary.en: The eastern edge of the Julian Alps, famous for exceptionally rich plant life. The climb from Bohinjska Bistrica is long and steady, and the summit is a grassy ridge with views both ways.

summary.sl: Najvišji vrh Kamniško-Savinjskih Alp. Vse poti so dolge in strme, zgornji deli pa potekajo po melišču in skalnatem svetu; ob snegu je to zimska tura.
summary.en: The highest summit in the Kamnik-Savinja Alps. Every route is long and steep, with scree and rock high up; with snow on it this becomes a full winter route.

summary.sl: Oster, prepoznaven vrh nad Logarsko dolino. Označene poti so zavarovane in izpostavljene, razgled na Savinjske Alpe pa je izjemen.
summary.en: A sharp, unmistakable peak above Logarska dolina. The marked routes are cabled and exposed, and the view across the Savinja Alps is exceptional.

summary.sl: Visoka kraška planota s pastirskim naseljem, ki je edinstveno v Evropi. Vzpon je nezahteven in primeren vse leto, planota pa je odprta in v megli zavajajoča.
summary.en: A high karst plateau with a herdsmen settlement unique in Europe. The climb is undemanding and works year round, but the plateau is open and disorienting in mist.

summary.sl: Razgleden vrh nad Cerkljami, poleti pašnik in pozimi smučišče. Iz Ambroža je to resen vzpon, z gondole pa krajši sprehod — zato je višinska razlika boljši pokazatelj napora kot nadmorska višina.
summary.en: A viewpoint above Cerklje, pasture in summer and a ski area in winter. From Ambrož it is a real climb; from the gondola it is a stroll — which is exactly why ascent, not altitude, measures the effort.

summary.sl: Najvišji vrh Karavank in obmejni greben nad Gorenjsko. Razgled sega od Julijcev do Avstrije, greben pa je odprt in izpostavljen vetru.
summary.en: The highest summit in the Karavanke and a border ridge above Gorenjska. The view runs from the Julian Alps into Austria; the ridge is open and wind-exposed.

summary.sl: Dolg travnat greben nad Begunjami, priljubljen zaradi razgleda na Triglav. Pot je označena in nezahtevna, greben pa je izpostavljen in ob megli zavajajoč.
summary.en: A long grassy ridge above Begunje, popular for its view of Triglav. The path is marked and undemanding; the ridge itself is exposed and confusing in mist.

summary.sl: Gozdnat vrh nad Tržičem, primeren tudi izven poletne sezone. Pot je lahka in dobro označena, razgled z vrha pa seže čez Gorenjsko.
summary.en: A wooded summit above Tržič that works well outside the summer season. The path is easy and clearly marked, and the view opens out across Gorenjska.

summary.sl: Najvišji vrh Pohorja — gozdnato, položno gorovje brez skalnatih sten. Poti so lahke in dolge, zato je Pohorje priljubljeno pozimi za turno smuko in tek na smučeh.
summary.en: The highest point of Pohorje — a rounded, forested massif with no rock faces. The paths are easy and long, which is why Pohorje is popular in winter for ski touring and cross-country.

summary.sl: Travnat, samoten vrh nad Senožečami z razgledom na Snežnik, Nanos in do morja. Brez sence in izpostavljen burji.
summary.en: A grassy, solitary summit above Senožeče with views to Snežnik, Nanos and the sea. There is no shade, and it is exposed to the burja.

summary.sl: Najvišji nealpski vrh Slovenije in osrednji vrh notranjskih gozdov. Vrh je kamnit in brez dreves, spodnja pobočja pa so med najbolj strnjenimi gozdovi v Evropi.
summary.en: The highest non-Alpine summit in Slovenia and the centre of the Notranjska forests. The top is bare and rocky, while the slopes below are some of the most continuous forest in Europe.

summary.sl: Osamljen vrh nad Halozami, ki mu pravijo štajerski Triglav. Pot je lahka in primerna vse leto, pobočja pa so znana po zgodnji pomladanski flori.
summary.en: An isolated summit above the Haloze hills, locally called the Styrian Triglav. The path is easy and works year round, and the slopes are known for early spring flowers.

summary.sl: Prepoznaven dvojni greben ob hrvaški meji. Kratek, a strm vzpon z nekaj skalnatimi mesti tik pod vrhom.
summary.en: A distinctive twin ridge on the Croatian border. A short but steep climb with a few rocky steps just below the top.

summary.sl: Najvišji vrh Zasavja, ki mu pravijo zasavski Triglav. Razgled sega čez osrednjo Slovenijo, pot pa je nezahtevna in primerna tudi pozimi.
summary.en: The highest summit in Zasavje, locally called the Zasavje Triglav. The view reaches across central Slovenia, and the path is undemanding and works in winter too.

summary.sl: Najvišja točka Prekmurja in Goričkega — nizka, a prava razgledna točka nad panonsko ravnino. Vzpon je kratek in primeren za vsakogar.
summary.en: The highest point of Prekmurje and the Goričko hills — low, but a genuine viewpoint over the Pannonian plain. A short climb suitable for anyone.

summary.sl: Druga najvišja slovenska gora, mogočna in precej manj obiskana od Triglava. Vse označene poti so dolge in zavarovane, zgornji del pa je izpostavljen.
summary.en: The second-highest mountain in Slovenia, imposing and far quieter than Triglav. Every marked route is long and cabled, and the upper section is exposed.

summary.sl: Vrh med Vršičem in dolino Trente z izrazitim skalnatim pobočjem. Označene poti so zavarovane in zahtevajo čelado ter samovarovalni komplet.
summary.en: A summit between Vršič and the Trenta valley with a striking rock face. The marked routes are cabled and require a helmet and via ferrata set.

summary.sl: Visok vrh nad Doliškim sedlom, pogosto obiskan v kombinaciji s Triglavom. Pot je dolga, a v zgornjem delu manj zahtevna od sosednjih vrhov.
summary.en: A high summit above the Dolič saddle, often combined with Triglav. The route is long but less demanding high up than its neighbours.

summary.sl: Strm vrh nad dolino Vrat z odličnim pogledom na Triglavovo severno steno. Pot je zahtevna in v zgornjem delu izpostavljena.
summary.en: A steep summit above the Vrata valley with an unmatched view of the Triglav north face. The route is demanding and exposed near the top.

summary.sl: Razgleden vrh nad Bohinjem, znan po pogledu na Triglavsko pogorje in Komno. Pot je dolga, a tehnično nezahtevna.
summary.en: A viewpoint above Bohinj, known for its outlook over the Triglav range and the Komna plateau. Long, but technically undemanding.

summary.sl: Tretji najvišji vrh Kamniško-Savinjskih Alp, pod katerim leži edini slovenski ledenik. Poti so dolge, strme in v zgornjem delu zavarovane.
summary.en: The third-highest summit in the Kamnik-Savinja Alps, below which lies the only glacier in Slovenia. The routes are long, steep and cabled high up.

summary.sl: Obsežen vrh med Ojstrico in Brano nad Kamniškim sedlom. Označene poti so zavarovane in izpostavljene.
summary.en: A broad summit between Ojstrica and Brana above the Kamnik saddle. The marked routes are cabled and exposed.

summary.sl: Vrh tik nad Kamniškim sedlom, pogosto prvi dvatisočak v Savinjskih Alpah. Pot s sedla je kratka, a zavarovana.
summary.en: A summit right above the Kamnik saddle, often a first two-thousander in the Savinja Alps. Short from the saddle, but cabled.

summary.sl: Vzhodni rob Savinjskih Alp, travnat in razgleden. Manj obiskan kot osrednji del pogorja, z lepim pogledom na Peco in Olševo.
summary.en: The eastern edge of the Savinja Alps, grassy and open. Quieter than the core of the range, with a fine view towards Peca and Olševa.

summary.sl: Obmejni greben nad Solčavo, znan po jami Potočka zijalka. Pot je nezahtevna, greben pa odprt in razgleden.
summary.en: A border ridge above Solčava, known for the Potočka zijalka cave. The path is undemanding and the ridge open and scenic.

summary.sl: Najvišja točka Košute, najdaljšega strnjenega grebena v Karavankah. Vzpon je dolg, zgornji del pa odprt in izpostavljen vetru.
summary.en: The highest point of Košuta, the longest continuous ridge in the Karavanke. A long climb, with an open, wind-exposed upper section.

summary.sl: Vrh nad Zelenico, med Stolom in Begunjščico. Zgornji del je strm in kamnit, razgled pa seže čez Gorenjsko in v Avstrijo.
summary.en: A summit above Zelenica, between Stol and Begunjščica. The upper section is steep and rocky, with a view across Gorenjska and into Austria.

summary.sl: Osamljen vrh nad Prevaljami s cerkvijo na vrhu, najvišjo v Sloveniji. Pot je lahka in primerna skoraj vse leto.
summary.en: An isolated summit above Prevalje with a church on top, the highest in Slovenia. The path is easy and works almost year round.

summary.sl: Vrh nad Cerkniškim jezerom, v ljudskem izročilu dom čarovnic. Kratek vzpon z razgledom na presihajoče jezero.
summary.en: A summit above Lake Cerknica, home of witches in local folklore. A short climb with a view over the intermittent lake.
